title: Eidolon — reproducible scientific data collections
conference: XX Brazilian e-Science Workshop (BreSci 2026), co-located with SBBD
scope: Run the original R ETLs for the complete climate, bioenergy and emissions source tables, followed by the original miniature-generation script. Each newly generated complete R object is compared semantically with the authors’ published full object at the same commit; published objects are references only, never substituted for ETL output. This is a three-collection instantiation of Eidolon, not every collection or remote publication. Origin: FAOSTAT https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/ET , https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/BE and https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/GT . Code is MIT; source data retain FAO terms. Three independent ETL branches and three dependent miniaturization activities expose real parallelism.
executionClaim: Adapted scientific workflow; completion and agreement are reported only by measured evidence.
